name: Oira wa Bandai ~Heisaku & Kenta no Yume Monogatari~
original_name: オイラは番台～平作＆健太の夢物語～
source:
One day, a police detective suddenly barged in a certain popular public bathhouse that the protagonist was in charge of.

“Dan Koutarou! You’re under arrest, under suspicion of sexual assault!”

With a clack, he was handcuffed.
Several months passed, and after a hellish series of interrogations, his guilt was established.

“Why, why am I the only one serving a prison sentence?
Why are Heisaku and Kenta getting away scott free?
But, it seems that is my fate…
Even if they were to be caught, it does not mean that my punishment would go away, but…
Is the public bathhouse that I inherited from my pops done for?
I’ve really done something awful to him…”

Meanwhile, Heisaku and Kenta...

"Man, I can’t believe we came out innocent."
"I feel kinda bad about pushing the blame solely on Koutarou, but this too is part of fate, huh."
"Kou-chan, just sit quietly in your cell!"
"So, we were cleared of suspicion, but what should we do from now on?"
"You’re right…for now, how about we go back to Koutarou’s shop, and peek in the bath once again?!"
"There’s also videos of those women we filmed that we haven’t used yet!"
"To begin with, let’s change bathhouse’s name!"

[From [url=https://j-addicts.de/vn-of-the-month-december-2003/]j-addicts[/url]]
translation:
一天，一名警探突然闯进主人公负责经营的某间人气澡堂。

「团幸太郎！你因涉嫌性侵犯被捕！」

咔哒一声，他被戴上手铐。
数月过去，经过一连串地狱般的审讯，他被判定有罪。

「为什么，为什么只有我在服刑？
为什么平作和健太能逍遥法外？
不过，看来这就是我的命运……
即使他们被抓到，我的刑罚也不会消失，但是……
父亲传下来的澡堂是不是完了？
我真是做了对不起他的事……」

与此同时，平作和健太……

「天啊，真不敢相信我们洗清罪名了。」
「把责任全推给幸太郎确实有点过意不去，不过这也是命运的一部分吧。」
「幸仔，就老老实实待在牢房里吧！」
「所以，我们洗清嫌疑了，接下来该怎么办？」
「也是……先回幸太郎的店里，再偷看一次澡堂怎么样！？」
「我们拍的那些女人的视频还没用完呢！」
「首先，把澡堂的名字改了吧！」
